result.instructions: Tools for Tillhub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What was my revenue yesterday, per branch?"; "Show the ten best-selling products this month."; "Which products are low on stock at my main branch?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tillhub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tillhub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tillhub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tillhub_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. tillhub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tillhub_get_account
tools.title: Get API user and account
tools.description: The Tillhub user behind the API key: role, scopes, account id and name (no credentials). GET /api/v0/me.

tools.name: tillhub_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (articles, variants, vouchers) with name, number, barcode, prices, taxes and product group. Filter by type, group, tag, barcode or custom id (barcode and custom_id are fast exact lookups and ignore the other filters). Page with next_query. GET /api/v1/products/{account}.

custom_id.description: Exact product number / custom id (ignores the other filters).

sellable.description: Only products suitable for sale (true) or not (false).

deleted.description: true = deleted products only; default non-deleted.

updated_since.description: Only products updated at or after this time. ISO 8601 date (2026-10-01) or date-time (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

next_query.description: next_query from the previous reply to get the following page. It already contains the filters, so the other arguments are ignored.

tools.name: tillhub_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Fuzzy search products by name and description (max 20 hits per page, with relevance score). GET /api/v2/products/{account}/search.

query.description: Search text; partial words are matched.

offset.description: Result offset for paging search results.
